Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} (revenant family, largely hidden even from the sect)

Patron Clan: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}

The youngest of the revenant families, the Oprichniki trace their origin only to the 16th century, when Ivan the Terrible divided his Russian kingdoms and named his secret militia after his principality of Oprichnina. These mortal mercenaries carried out Ivan's reign of terror against his own people, flaying dissenters and boiling the Tsar's enemies alive — until Ivan turned the Oprichniki against each other in his final, most paranoid years, and only the vilest of their lot survived. Russian Tzimisce took the survivors in as vassals, and over the following century the family became revenants in truth, even though none of them ever served on the Carpathians' cursed native soil.

Role: Henchmen, majordomos, intermediaries, mouthpieces, bodyguards and cutthroats for Russian Tzimisce, trained from birth to fill whichever of these roles is needed.

Disciplines: Animalism, Obfuscate, Vicissitude

Weakness: Every Oprichniki, regardless of where they were born or raised, is haunted by at least one ghost, as ruinous and inescapable as a three-point Supernatural Flaw. Russian koldunic lore holds the ghosts are the restless victims of Novgorod, the city Ivan's Oprichniki annihilated in a campaign of massacre and torture during his reign. Even a revenant who somehow banishes her ghost through Disciplines or magic finds another one takes its place before long — the curse always finds its way back to the bloodline.

Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, the Oprichniki remain a closely guarded secret even from most of Clan Tzimisce, serving only independent Russian Tzimisce and those aligned with the non-Sabbat Oradea League — a fact that leaves their full loyalty to the Sabbat in real doubt, and makes elders wary of what would happen if the sect at large learned the family had been kept hidden.

Advantage: As a hereditary revenant family, the Oprichniki are born ghouls who possess their family Disciplines innately: Dominate, Potence, Vicissitude.

Disadvantage: The Oprichniki are bred as loyal enforcers and assassins; bound by blood and breeding to their vampiric masters, they are born and raised as living tools rather than free agents, and inbreeding has left the line physically and mentally frail in places.
